name: forge-engine
description: Idea → validated → designed → built → verified → shipped. A gated, memory-backed product pipeline for coding agents: evidence-checked validation, design system + screenshot critique, stack packs, code & security review, QA coverage, deploy with real checks.

deploy_preview_access.title: Vercel preview access (optional)
deploy_preview_access.description: Only for Vercel previews behind Deployment Protection: the protection-bypass value from your own Vercel project. forge sends it as x-vercel-protection-bypass to the deployment under test and gives it to your e2e command. Leave empty otherwise.
